newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds rebound mildly on light Fri.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds rebound mildly on light Fri.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities rose about a third of a point in some coupons on Friday, putting an end to a week of falling prices.
Treasuries' gains outstripped those of mortgage-backeds during the session, but mortgages outperformed Treasuries all week.
"Mortgages have been doing very well against Treasuries," one trader said. "We might have lagged a little in this last little updraft," he added.
ARMs and 30-year fixed-rate paper was said to have attracted buyers during Friday's session.
